arxiv-1604-03027.title: Comparative Analysis of Finite Field-dependent BRST Transformations Thanks: Talk presented at SQS’15, 03 August – 08 August, 2015, at JINR, Dubna, Russia
arxiv-1604-03027.creator: Pavel Yu. Moshin, Alexander A. Reshetnyak
arxiv-1604-03027.description: Abstract We present a review of our recent study [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 , 6 ] , in which the concept of finite field-dependent BRST and BRST-antiBRST transformations for gauge theories was introduced, and their properties investigated.

arxiv-1904-07730.title: The cosmological constant and a scalar field coupled non minimally to gravity
arxiv-1904-07730.creator: M. Novello and A.E.S. Hartmann
arxiv-1904-07730.description: A 2019 arXiv research paper by M. Novello and A.E.S. Hartmann. We show that the combined minimal and non minimal interaction with the gravitational field may produce the generation of a cosmological constant without self-interaction of the scalar field. In the same vein we analyze the existence of states of a scalar field that by a combined interaction of minimal and non minimal coupling with the gravitational field can exhibit an unexpected property, to wit, they are acted on by the gravitational field but do not generate gravitational field.

arxiv-2011-12176.description: Abstract In this paper we mainly study large time behavior for the strong solutions of the finite extensible nonlinear elastic (FENE) dumbbell model. There is a lot results about the L 2 L^{2} decay rate of the co-rotation model. In this paper, we consider the general case.

arxiv-2106-08664.title: Virtual QCD corrections to gluon-initiated diphoton plus jet production at hadron colliders Preprint: CAVENDISH-HEP-21/10, IPPP/20/115, MPP-2021-86, TTP21-019, ZU-TH 26/21
arxiv-2106-08664.creator: Simon Badger, Christian Brønnum-Hansen, Dmitry Chicherin, Thomas Gehrmann, Heribertus Bayu Hartanto, Johannes Henn, Matteo Marcoli, Ryan Moodie, Tiziano Peraro, Simone Zoia
arxiv-2106-08664.description: Abstract We present an analytic computation of the gluon-initiated contribution to diphoton plus jet production at hadron colliders up to two loops in QCD. We reconstruct the analytic form of the finite remainders from numerical evaluations over finite fields including all colour contributions. Compact expressions are found using the pentagon function basis.

arxiv-2108-10515.description: Abstract . Virtual try-on technology enables users to try various fashion items using augmented reality and provides a convenient online shopping experience. However, most previous works focus on the virtual try-on for clothes while neglecting that for shoes, which is also a promising task.

arxiv-2111-13291.title: Influence of atomic FAA on ParallelFor and a cost model for improvements
arxiv-2111-13291.creator: Ran Shuai
arxiv-2111-13291.description: Abstract A bstract - this paper focuses on one of the most frequently visited multithreading library interfaces - ParallelFor. In this study, it is inferred that ParallelFor’s end-to-end latency performance is noticeably affected by the frequency with which fetch-and-add (FAA) is called during program execution. This can be explained by ParallelFor’s uniform semantics and the utilization of atomic FAA.

arxiv-2305-05730.title: Partial Plateau’s Problem with H H -mass
arxiv-2305-05730.creator: Enrique Alvarado, Qinglan Xia
arxiv-2305-05730.description: Abstract Classically, Plateau’s problem asks to find a surface of least area with a given boundary B B . In this article, we investigate a version of Plateau’s problem, where the boundary of an admissible surface is only required to partially span B B .

arxiv-2307-16224.title: On Abelian Groups Having Isomorphic Proper Strongly Invariant Subgroups
arxiv-2307-16224.creator: Andrey R. Chekhlov
arxiv-2307-16224.description: Abstract We consider two variants of those Abelian groups with all proper strongly invariant subgroups isomorphic and give an in-depth study of their basic and specific properties in either parallel or contrast to the Abelian groups with all proper fully invariant (respectively, characteristic) subgroups isomorphic, which are studied in details by the current authors in Commun.

arxiv-2502-17017.title: Quantifying Logical Consistency in Transformers via Query-Key Alignment
arxiv-2502-17017.creator: Eduard Tulchinskii, Anastasia Voznyuk, Laida Kushnareva, Andrei Andriiainen, Irina Piontkovskaya, Evgeny Burnaev, Serguei Barannikov
arxiv-2502-17017.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive performance in various natural language processing tasks, yet their ability to perform multi-step logical reasoning remains an open challenge. Although Chain-of-Thought prompting has improved logical reasoning by enabling models to generate intermediate steps, it lacks mechanisms to assess the coherence of these logical transitions.

arxiv-2505-10576.title: Robust Photo-Realistic Hand Gesture Generation: from Single View to Multiple View
arxiv-2505-10576.creator: Qifan Fu, Xu Chen, Muhammad Asad, Shanxin Yuan, Changjae Oh, Gregory Slabaugh
arxiv-2505-10576.description: Abstract . High-fidelity hand gesture generation represents a significant challenge in human-centric generation tasks. Existing methods typically employ a single-view mesh-rendered image prior to enhancing gesture generation quality. However, the spatial complexity of hand gestures and the inherent limitations of single-view rendering make it difficult to capture complete gesture information, particularly when fingers are occluded.

arxiv-2506-11806.title: Fermion masses and mixings in supersymmetric SO(10)
arxiv-2506-11806.creator: Qaisar Shafi
arxiv-2506-11806.description: Abstract We discuss the charged and neutral fermion masses and mixings in a supersymmetric SO(10) model with a minimal Higgs sector consisting of the multiplets 10 H 10_{H} , 45 H 45_{H} , and 16 H + 16 ¯ H 16_{H}+\overline{16}_{H} .

arxiv-2508-09849.title: ARI3D: A Software for Interactive Quantification of Regions in X-Ray CT 3D Images
arxiv-2508-09849.creator: Jan Phillipp Albrecht, Jose R.A. Godinho, Christina Hübers, Deborah Schmidt
arxiv-2508-09849.description: Abstract X-ray computed tomography (CT) is the main 3D technique for imaging the internal microstructures of materials. Quantitative analysis of the microstructures is usually achieved by applying a sequence of steps that are implemented to the entire 3D image. This is challenged by various imaging artifacts inherent from the technique, e.g., beam hardening and partial volume.

arxiv-2510-25589.title: BlazEr1: The eROSITA Blazar Catalog
arxiv-2510-25589.creator: S. Hämmerich, A. Gokus, F. McBride, P. Weber, L. Marcotulli, A. Zainab, W. Collmar, M. Salvato, J. Wolf, T. Sbarrato, S. Belladitta, J. Buchner, S. Saeedi, L. Dauner, M. Lorenz, O. König, C. Kirsch, K. Berger, S. Bahic, D. Tubín-Arenas, M. Krumpe, D. Homan, A. Markowitz, P. Benke, F. Rösch, P. Rajas
arxiv-2510-25589.description: Abstract Aims. eROSITA on board of the Spectrum Roentgen Gamma (SRG) spacecraft performed its first X-ray all-sky survey (eRASS1) between December 2019 and June 2020. It detected about 930000 sources, providing us with an unprecedented opportunity for a detailed blazar census. We present the properties of blazars and blazar candidates in eRASS1 and the compilation of the eROSITA blazar catalog.

pmc-11450740.title: Facet-Engineered BiVO4 Photocatalysts for Water Oxidation: Lifetime Gain Versus Energetic Loss
pmc-11450740.creator: Tianhao He, Yue Zhao, Daniele Benetti, Benjamin Moss, Lei Tian, Shababa Selim, Rengui Li, Fengtao Fan, Qian Li, Xiuli Wang, Can Li, James R. Durrant
pmc-11450740.description: A limiting factor to the efficiency of water Oxygen Evolution Reaction (OER) in metal oxide nanoparticle photocatalysts is the rapid recombination of holes and electrons. Facet-engineering can effectively improve charge separation and, consequently, OER efficiency. However, the kinetics behind this improvement remain poorly understood.

pmc-11573982.title: Computational analysis of variability and uncertainty in the clinical reference on magnetic resonance imaging radiomics: modelling and performance
pmc-11573982.creator: Cindy Xue, Jing Yuan, Gladys G Lo, Darren MC Poon, Winnie CW Chu
pmc-11573982.description: To conduct a computational investigation to explore the influence of clinical reference uncertainty on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) radiomics feature selection, modelling, and performance. This study used two sets of publicly available prostate cancer MRI = radiomics data (Dataset 1: n = 260; Dataset 2: n = 100) with Gleason score clinical references.

pmc-12569494.title: Use and User Experience of a Preconception Lifestyle App for Couples Undergoing in Vitro Fertilization: Mixed Methods Study
pmc-12569494.creator: Tessy Boedt, Sharon Lie Fong, Eline Dancet, Merijn Mestdagh, Joke Verbeke, David Geerts, Carl Spiessens, Christophe Matthys, Andre Kushniruk, Le-Giang Tran, Yan Wang
pmc-12569494.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundMobile apps are a promising way to improve healthy lifestyle behavior among people with infertility. However, sufficient engagement with mobile health apps is crucial to influence health outcomes, and identifying features to create more effective interventions is urgently needed.ObjectiveThis study conducted a process evaluation focusing on the use and user experience of the PreLiFe app, a mobile lifestyle app for couples undergoing in vitro fertilization (IVF).MethodsA mixed methods approach was used among heterosexual couples with infertility undergoing IVF.

pmc-13274957.title: Role of Radiotherapy in an Inflammatory Pseudotumor of the Maxillary Sinus and Imaging Findings: A Case Report
pmc-13274957.creator: Ricardo Mendoza Coronado, Ana Karen Luna Marroquin, Laura Estefany Purata Hernandez, Rafael Piñeiro Retif, Oscar Vidal Gutierrez
pmc-13274957.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Inflammatory pseudotumor (IPT) is a benign lesion of inflammatory origin that can mimic a malignant neoplasm because of its aggressive clinical and imaging behavior, particularly in uncommon locations such as the paranasal sinuses.In this article, we present the case of a patient diagnosed with IPT of the left maxillary sinus, which demonstrated extension into adjacent soft tissues and secondary involvement of cranial nerves due to extensive local invasion.
